questions.question: Stance?
questions.answer: Calm and exact: terminal/developer language, dark graphite, one signal colour, the null idea. No brooms or sparkles.

questions.question: Collect competitor marks over the network?
questions.answer: No. Design from the brief; originality evidence stays local.

questions.question: Round 1 decision?
questions.answer: Combine B + C: the emptied-l wordmark idea of null-stem with the backslash-zero icon and blue of slashed-zero.

questions.question: Which icon?
questions.answer: C: solid l + hollow l, derived from the word.
